venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Club Paraiso, Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492001

items.information: **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurRubiksCubeChallenge2017#1974-registrations-payments) tab. **Returning participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition. Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurRubiksCubeChallenge2017#1974-registrations-payments) tab. **Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.** For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurRubiksCubeChallenge2017#1974-registrations-payments). For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurRubiksCubeChallenge2017#1980-schedule).
